interpretation.status: Row status is normative/integrated and can only be NOT_RUN or BLOCKED.
interpretation.component_observation: PASS means only the explicitly scoped observed component assertions; PARTIAL means narrower evidence exists; NOT_RUN means no credited execution of that component obligation.
interpretation.integrated_acceptance: All accepted flags are false. No AM,GNATIVE,Task,Relay,Schedule,provider,Revisor,campaign review,C/D/G4/G7 acceptance is issued.
interpretation.source_run_identity: W1/W2/W3 and their snapshots remain distinct; later evidence does not relabel earlier failed runs or prove targetC/D.
interpretation.count_rule: Unique operation IDs are counted by actual entry/producer scope. Test count, number of receipts and number of leases are not business operation count.
interpretation.catalog_rule: Files, manifest entries, descriptors or reserved source presence are not loading or execution evidence.
interpretation.routine_rule: Six absent-native/publication operations remain unadvertised; no artificial negative invocation or receipt is manufactured to claim delivery.
interpretation.review_rule: Auxiliary source inspections are not the three independent final campaign judgments or reviewer-model execution.

runtime_counts.note: Counts are unique operation identifiers, not test counts or total invocation counts. Public four is a subset of MCP nine. R1-BRIDGE.supports: Six snapshot/input/result/observer/raw-identity controls passed; descriptor/authority fixtures remain synthetic component inputs.

R1-CATALOG.supports: Actual bundle ceilings and domain descriptor composition checked; 39 canonical routes and 33 domain descriptors, with six native operations unadvertised without native/publication readiness. No 39-handler execution.

R1-REGISTRY.supports: Registry replay, forged bindings, concurrent request authorities, manifest ceilings and mutable-admission checks; synthetic component admissions.

R1-PRIVATE.supports: Private SDK provider collision and current authority/generation/abort/configuration at transport closure; real SDK close paths with declared harness descriptors.

R1-REGISTRATION.supports: Reserved directory registration, missing source and exact grants; registration alone is not loading.

R1-DOMAIN.supports: Real domain handler positives: public Dashboard/KPI/BI, direct SDK Planner scenarios, recorded-ingress WP06 document/search/import; scope and synthetic admission/scanner boundaries remain explicit.

R2-LOADS.supports: 25 observed SessionV2.skill receipts, 18 skills, 5 profiles; persisted message and byte digests. Copied/transplanted source capabilities, changed/missing bytes and forged grants are rejected.

R2-BINDINGS.supports: 39 operation leases across 14 actual skill-loading sessions; revocation rejects existing/new leases. No business handlers execute in this proof.

R2-PUBLIC.supports: Finance profile/forecast skill loads, public Tools/ToolRegistry settlement, private MCP, real Planner and UI parity; two distinct actual Sessions with synthetic finance/admin authority and case/run labels, differences12000/6000.

R2-SOURCE-FENCE.supports: Disposal of actual registered source during delayed final byte-read denies skill-source-changed without issuing a receipt.

R3-DOMAIN-UI.supports: Four additional domain/UI operations: request_read, supplier_read, contract_read, work_list; no public native wrapper proof.

R3-REPORTS.supports: Review/report/artifact handlers, renderer/store/download/reopen run with explicitly synthetic business projections; fabricated auxiliary C07 records do not prove routine admission.

R4-FENCES.supports: Real loaded receipts support expiry, missing-receipt and routine-result prepare/run ceiling negatives. Catalog/status/result leases do not call routine handlers.

FAILURES.supports: R1 retains8 failures (7 repaired fixture failures qualified inR2; preview-link failure remains). R3 retains13 failures:6 sourcing case-evidence and7 collaboration case-state prerequisites. Owner proposals are inert/not run.

SCOPE.supports: 9 unique MCP/SDK positives,4 public ToolRegistry positives,4 additional real-domain UI positives,3 UI handlers on synthetic business projections,23 operations without credited positive canonical call. These scopes never count as39executed handlers.

MATRIX.supports: Exact8packs/39operations, schemas, handlers and5profiles/18skills mapping; presence and mapping do not prove execution.

DELTA.supports: Two owned production fixes and auxiliary cold code review; source manifest describes W1 inputs and is not updated here or treated as a final integrated admission.
